name: benchmark_ReFineID_Diffusion
description: A benchmark for evaluating identity preservation and refinement in diffusion-based image generation models. It provides image pairs and evaluation routines to measure how well models maintain or recover subject identity after generation or editing, using perceptual and identity-similarity metrics. The suite is intended for comparing diffusion variants on identity fidelity and visual quality.
reputation: Available on Hugging Face and used in a focused community researching identity fidelity in generative diffusion models; adoption is limited but relevant to image-generation evaluation.
